doc.title: Lou Donaldson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Setting up his 1952 Blue Note session
summary: He organized the 10-inch session himself with Horace Silver, Blue Mitchell, Art Taylor and Gene Ramey.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: I guess you did three 10-inch recordings...or two—one in 1952, one in 1954. The first one is with Horace Silver and Art Blakey and Blue Mitchell, and Gene Ramey.
It wasn’t Art Blakey. Art Taylor. Gene Ramey.
Were these guys you were working with?
How did the session get set up?
I set it up myself. We just went down and played them.
These are things you’d been playing?
It wasn’t no great stretch to play them.
Do you remember...were you working that week?
